title: 作品制作
subtitle: Work Production
keywords: Work production 2.Media technology 3.Media design 4.Integration of knowledge, technology and sensibility 5.Regional cooperation
educationalGoal: In this course, students will learn to produce and construct video works, audio works, computer systems, etc., by integrating the knowledge and experience they have acquired in the fields of Media Technology and Media Design from their first year. Students will also experience the integration of logical and scientific thinking and the sensibilities developed in the production of works and systems.
advice: In this seminar-based course, students produce video works, sound works, computer systems, etc. under instructor's direction. Before taking this course, students are required to review the knowledge and skills acquired from the first year in this department. Students will be required to work hard to achieve their goals. This course is designed not only for students to experience PDIII learning content in advance, but also to develop PDIII research content through that experience. Therefore, students must take seriously the advice and criticisms of their supervisors and examiners. The results may be presented after mid-February, so students are required to adjust their schedules. This course may not be taken at the same term as Project Design Ⅲ. Note that students not belonging to the laboratory to carry out Graduation research (PDIII) cannot take this course.
